sources.review: Visually reviewed: one circumferential sealing band at each end of each double-ended piston. Author calls these Teflon compressor seal rings. Tan/brown appearance, not a scale or material analysis. The 1998 Crown Victoria comparison does not identify truck dimensions.

candidate.shaft_axis: Global +X toward radiator; local +Z transformed by Y+90 degrees
candidate.mounting: Four provisional front ear faces X432.56; holes Y210/350, Z60/140, radius5.5, 12 mm rearward thickness. Shared support study is owned by accessory_brackets.py.
candidate.sourced_constraints: Five double-ended pistons, ten shoes, ten PTFE sealing rings by comparison teardown; 145 mm clutch envelope and six grooves from UAC; 0.6 mm selected gap within Ford range.
candidate.provisional_dimensions: 130 mm body OD, 26 mm bores, 37 mm piston-axis pitch radius, 18 degree swash inclination, 24.044 mm piston stroke, cases/heads/ports, all shaft, seal, bearing, reed, bolt and mounting details.
candidate.kinematics: Each piston axial offset is -tan(18deg)*37*cos(pistonAngle-shaftPhase). Shoes follow the tilted swash plane with a 0.2 mm illustrative face gap and 0.1 mm spherical cup clearance. No refrigerant or contact-force solver.
candidate.refrigerant_limit: Rear head ports reach separate annular suction/discharge plenums and matching valve holes/reeds. Longitudinal passages joining the two heads remain absent, so no complete closed refrigerant network is claimed.
candidate.bearing_limit: Two three-piece thrust stacks are decomposed into two races and one rolling-element envelope cartridge each. Pulley bearing is one cartridge; individual balls/rollers, cages and real counts are unresolved.
candidate.scope: Static illustrative component reconstruction and eight sampled shaft poses, not a production fit, pressure-tight compressor, continuously verified motion, or servicing instructions.
